races.title: Board of Trustees
races.context: Hanan Eldahry, who has served since 2018, is not seeking reelection. The central issue in this race is fiscal management - the village passed a {{fact:village-budget-fy2627}} budget with a {{fact:village-budget-increase-fy2627}} increase, overriding the state tax cap for the first time. Three seats are up; top three vote-getters win.

shared_platforms.neighborhood-party-2026: In their joint platform statement, Long, Speros and Anzilotti describe the Village's current path as 'unsustainable,' citing debt growth from {{fact:village-debt-2021}} in 2021 to {{fact:village-debt-2026}} now, undisciplined spending, and lack of transparency on the Picture House RFQ. They pledge to: serve without pay, vote not to exceed the tax cap, create an infrastructure plan, and bring openness to Village decisions.

candidates.name: Russell Solomon
candidates.meta: Incumbent . First elected 2020 . Running for third term
candidates.summary: Now in his third term, Solomon emphasizes a collaborative approach: "I've made it a point to sit down directly with neighbors, local groups and business owners, understand what they need from their village government, and follow through." Key achievements: championed 25 mph speed limit village-wide, supported hiring of a Traffic Safety Officer, worked on sewer infrastructure. Has served as liaison for pedestrian safety, DPW, and downtown business.
